meta.name: llama-cpp
meta.description: Runs LLM inference on CPU, Apple Silicon, and consumer GPUs without NVIDIA hardware. Use for edge deployment, M1/M2/M3 Macs, AMD/Intel GPUs, or when CUDA is unavailable. Supports GGUF quantization (1.5-8 bit) for reduced memory and 4-10× speedup vs PyTorch on CPU.

copy.tagline: 在无NVIDIA硬件的设备上运行大模型推理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在没有NVIDIA显卡的电脑上运行大语言模型。
copy.tagline_en: Run LLM inference on devices without NVIDIA hardware
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run large language models on devices without NVIDIA GPUs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以在没有 NVIDIA 显卡的电脑上运行大语言模型，支持 CPU、苹果芯片和 AMD/Intel 显卡，还能使用 GGUF 量化格式节省内存并加速推理。
howto.when: 当你在没有 NVIDIA 显卡的设备上部署大语言模型，或者需要在边缘设备（如树莓派）上运行推理时触发。

say.text: 用 llama.cpp 在 M3 Mac 上运行 Llama 2 7B 模型。
say.note: Claude 会指导你安装并运行模型。

say.text: 帮我用 GGUF 量化一个 7B 模型，选 Q4_K_M 格式。
say.note: Claude 会给出量化命令和参数。

say.text: 启动 llama.cpp 的 OpenAI 兼容服务器。
say.note: Claude 会提供启动命令和 API 调用示例。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run large language models on devices without NVIDIA GPUs, supporting CPU, Apple Silicon, and AMD/Intel GPUs. It uses GGUF quantization to reduce memory usage and speed up inference.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to deploy LLMs on non-NVIDIA hardware, edge devices like Raspberry Pi, or when CUDA is unavailable.

say_en.text: Run Llama 2 7B on M3 Mac using llama.cpp.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through installation and execution.

say_en.text: Quantize a 7B model to GGUF Q4_K_M format.
say_en.note: Claude will provide the quantization command.

say_en.text: Start an OpenAI-compatible server with llama.cpp.
say_en.note: Claude will give the server command and API example.
